_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score/sentiment sit near the Complacency band with dead ETF flows and flat funding inside a 24% coil base rate; no named breaker justifies leaving HOLD.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD toward Complacency; narrative has no forward phase/direction call (oil-only)
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 45-60 and 30d momentum stays mid-range with no ETF-flow shock, score inside 47-54
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 40 with long-flush and rising realized vol (back to Anxiety) or ETF flows rebound hard with F&G above 62 (into Disbelief)
